dish.title: Sheet-Pan Crispy Gnocchi with Brussels Sprouts and Apples
dish.description: Shelf-stable potato gnocchi roasted straight from the package until golden and crisp, with deeply browned Brussels sprouts, red onion, and apple wedges, finished in a sticky maple-Dijon-cider glaze with fresh thyme. Egg-free, dairy-free gnocchi contracted; no Parmesan, no butter, no nuts.

recipe_version.title: Sheet-Pan Crispy Gnocchi with Brussels Sprouts and Apples
recipe_version.description: Shelf-stable potato gnocchi roasted straight from the package until golden and crisp, with deeply browned Brussels sprouts, red onion, and apple wedges, finished in a sticky maple-Dijon-cider glaze with fresh thyme. Egg-free, dairy-free gnocchi contracted; no Parmesan, no butter, no nuts.

ingredients.name: shelf-stable potato gnocchi
ingredients.note: Two 16- to 17.6-oz vacuum-sealed shelf-stable packages (about 2 lb total). REQUIRED HH001 shopping contract: the ingredient label lists no milk, milk powder, whey, cheese, butter, or egg (typical label: potato, wheat flour, potato starch, salt). Do not use refrigerated fresh gnocchi, ricotta gnocchi, cheese-filled gnocchi, or cauliflower gnocchi. Roast straight from the package; do not boil.

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts
ingredients.preparation: trimmed, halved through the stem (quartered if wider than 1.5 inches)

ingredients.name: crisp apples
ingredients.display_name: crisp apples (Honeycrisp, Fuji, or Pink Lady)
ingredients.note: about 8 oz each; skin on for color

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.preparation: cut into 1-inch wedges through the root end

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp for the sprout pan, 3 tbsp for the gnocchi pan. No butter.

ingredients.name: fresh thyme
ingredients.note: from about 8 sprigs; 2 tsp on the gnocchi pan, 1 tsp in the glaze

ingredients.name: Dijon mustard
ingredients.note: mustard is not a US major allergen and has no runtime allergen token; disclosed in allergen_notes

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 3/4 tsp sprout pan, 1/2 tsp gnocchi pan, 1/4 tsp glaze

steps.title: Heat the oven and prep
steps.body: Set racks in the upper-middle and lower-middle positions and heat the oven to 450°F. The oven preheats during this prep and the pan loading in step 2 (about 15 minutes total; preheat overlap stated, so it is not added to cook time). Trim and halve the Brussels sprouts. Core the apples and cut into 3/4-inch wedges. Cut the red onion into 1-inch wedges through the root. Strip the thyme leaves. In a small bowl whisk the maple syrup, cider vinegar, Dijon, 1 tsp thyme, and 1/4 tsp salt; this is the glaze. Open the gnocchi and break apart any pieces stuck together. HARD CONTRACT: gnocchi label shows no milk, whey, cheese, butter, or egg; no Parmesan or butter anywhere in this recipe.

steps.title: Load two sheet pans
steps.body: Pan 1: toss the sprouts and onion with 2 tbsp olive oil, 3/4 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper; turn the sprouts cut-side down. Pan 2: toss the uncooked gnocchi and apple wedges with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper, and 2 tsp thyme; spread in a single layer with a little space between pieces so they crisp instead of steam.

steps.title: Roast
steps.body: Roast the gnocchi pan on the upper rack and the sprout pan on the lower rack for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Flip, swap, and finish roasting
steps.body: With a thin metal spatula, flip the gnocchi and apples; toss the sprouts and onion. Swap rack positions. Roast 10 minutes more, until the gnocchi are puffed, golden, and crisp at the edges, the apples are browned at the edges but still hold their shape, and the sprouts are deeply browned on the cut sides and tender when pierced.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.body: Drizzle the glaze over both pans, about half on each, and toss. Return to the oven for 3 minutes, until the glaze bubbles and turns sticky.

steps.title: Combine and serve
steps.body: Slide the sprouts and onion onto the gnocchi pan (or a warm platter) and toss gently. Taste; add a pinch of salt if needed. Serve right away while the gnocchi are crisp. No Parmesan, no butter, no nuts. kitchen_tested is false.

components.name: roasted gnocchi, sprouts, apples, and onion

recipe_version.heat: 450°F oven, two racks (upper-middle and lower-middle). Preheat overlaps prep.
recipe_version.doneness: Gnocchi puffed, golden, and crisp at the edges with soft centers. Sprouts deeply browned on cut sides and knife-tender. Apples browned at edges but holding shape. Glaze sticky, not pooled. kitchen_tested is false.

dietary_eligibility.nut_policy_note: No peanuts, tree nuts, or cashews. The HH001 cashew exception is not used.
dietary_eligibility.hh001_reason: Plant-based sheet-pan dinner. No dairy (no Parmesan, no butter; gnocchi contracted milk-free), no shellfish, no meat, no poultry, no fish. Gnocchi also contracted egg-free so plant_based holds unconditionally. Nuts absent. Wheat present (HH001 allows wheat).

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Unconditional dairy_free, vegetarian, and plant_based. The shelf-stable gnocchi must list no milk, whey, cheese, butter, or egg; that is a hard shopping contract, not a conditional dairy claim. No Parmesan, no butter, no brown-butter sauce.
allergen_notes: Wheat covers the wheat flour in the shelf-stable potato gnocchi.
Mustard (Dijon) is present. It is not a US major allergen and has no FlavorWeave runtime token; disclosed here for households that track it.
No egg or milk: the gnocchi contract excludes milk, whey, cheese, butter, and egg. No soy, sesame, peanut, tree_nut, shellfish, or finfish in the written ingredients.
